newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Nov palm oil output seen down 13 pct-Wong.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Nov palm oil output seen down 13 pct-Wong.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil output in November was estimated to have fallen by 13 percent to 770,000 tonnes over October, crop forecaster Ivan Wong said on Thursday.
Wong estimated end-November palm oil stocks at 980,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 953,241 tonnes at end-October.
He said palm oil exports in November were projected to be 650,000 tonnes against PORLA's 727,629 tonnes in October.
"Production for the first-half November fell between 15-20 percent due to fewer working hours arising from the Deepavali holidays on Nov 10-11," Wong said in this latest report.

"Production this month may also be affected by weather conditions as the rainy season has started this week. So far widespread showers and/or thunderstorms occured mostly in the late afternoon or evenings," he said.
Wong said stocks of palm oil now appear unlikely to reach the one million tonnes level due to better than expected exports.
